diff --git a/internal/store/store.go b/internal/store/store.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9b7ba36
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/store/store.go
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+// Package store keeps the app's data: users, sessions, notes, tags and
+// share links. sqlite.Open builds the Store the server holds.
+package store
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// ErrNotFound is what every getter answers for a row that is not there —
+// including another user's note, which the API must show as 404.
+var ErrNotFound = errors.New("store: not found")
+
+// User is an account. PasswordHash is bcrypt; it never leaves the store in
+// a User sent to a handler's answer.
+type User struct {
+	ID           int64
+	Username     string
+	PasswordHash string
+	CreatedAt    time.Time
+}
+
+// Session is a login: Token is the cookie's value, Expires the instant the
+// session stops being valid.
+type Session struct {
+	Token     string
+	UserID    int64
+	Expires   time.Time
+	CreatedAt time.Time
+}
+
+// Note is one note of one user. Tags are the lower-cased names attached to
+// it; Pinned orders it before all others in a listing.
+type Note struct {
+	ID        int64
+	UserID    int64
+	Title     string
+	Body      string
+	Tags      []string
+	Pinned    bool
+	CreatedAt time.Time
+	UpdatedAt time.Time
+}
+
+// Share is a read-only link to a note. Token is 22 URL-safe characters;
+// RevokedAt is nil while the link answers.
+type Share struct {
+	Token      string
+	NoteID     int64
+	UserID     int64
+	CreatedAt  time.Time
+	RevokedAt  *time.Time
+	ShareCount int64
+}
+
+// TagCount is one tag of a user with the number of their notes carrying it.
+type TagCount struct {
+	Tag   string
+	Count int
+}
+
+// ListNotesOptions narrows a listing. Empty values ask for everything.
+type ListNotesOptions struct {
+	// Tag keeps the notes carrying that tag (lower-cased).
+	Tag string
+	// Q is a case-insensitive substring of title or body.
+	Q string
+	// Page is 1-based; PageSize is the notes per page when greater than 0.
+	Page     int
+	PageSize int
+}
+
+// NotePage is one page of a listing with the total of matching notes.
+type NotePage struct {
+	Notes []Note
+	Total int
+}
+
+// Store is the app's whole persistence contract. Every feature card gets
+// this interface, never the sqlite type behind it.
+type Store interface {
+	CreateUser(username, passwordHash string) (*User, error)
+	GetUserByUsername(username string) (*User, error)
+
+	CreateSession(userID int64, token string, expires time.Time) (*Session, error)
+	GetSession(token string) (*Session, error)
+	DeleteSession(token string) error
+
+	CreateNote(userID int64, title, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error)
+	GetNote(noteID, userID int64) (*Note, error)
+	ListNotes(userID int64, opts ListNotesOptions) (*NotePage, error)
+	UpdateNote(noteID, userID int64, title, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error)
+	DeleteNote(noteID, userID int64) error
+	PinNote(noteID, userID int64) (*Note, error)
+	UnpinNote(noteID, userID int64) (*Note, error)
+
+	CreateShare(noteID, userID int64, token string) (*Share, error)
+	GetShare(token string) (*Note, error)
+	RevokeShare(shareID, userID int64) error
+
+	ListTags(userID int64) ([]TagCount, error)
+
+	Close() error
+}

+// Package store keeps the app's data: users, sessions, notes, tags and
+// share links. sqlite.Open builds the Store the server holds.
+package store
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// ErrNotFound is what every getter answers for a row that is not there —
+// including another user's note, which the API must show as 404.
+var ErrNotFound = errors.New("store: not found")
+
+// User is an account. PasswordHash is bcrypt; it never leaves the store in
+// a User sent to a handler's answer.
+type User struct {
+	ID           int64
+	Username     string
+	PasswordHash string
+	CreatedAt    time.Time
+}
+
+// Session is a login: Token is the cookie's value, Expires the instant the
+// session stops being valid.
+type Session struct {
+	Token     string
+	UserID    int64
+	Expires   time.Time
+	CreatedAt time.Time
+}
+
+// Note is one note of one user. Tags are the lower-cased names attached to
+// it; Pinned orders it before all others in a listing.
+type Note struct {
+	ID        int64
+	UserID    int64
+	Title     string
+	Body      string
+	Tags      []string
+	Pinned    bool
+	CreatedAt time.Time
+	UpdatedAt time.Time
+}
+
+// Share is a read-only link to a note. Token is 22 URL-safe characters;
+// RevokedAt is nil while the link answers.
+type Share struct {
+	Token      string
+	NoteID     int64
+	UserID     int64
+	CreatedAt  time.Time
+	RevokedAt  *time.Time
+	ShareCount int64
+}
+
+// TagCount is one tag of a user with the number of their notes carrying it.
+type TagCount struct {
+	Tag   string
+	Count int
+}
+

+	// Tag keeps the notes carrying that tag (lower-cased).
+	Tag string
+	// Q is a case-insensitive substring of title or body.
+	Q string
+	// Page is 1-based; PageSize is the notes per page when greater than 0.
+	Page     int
+	PageSize int
+}
+
+// NotePage is one page of a listing with the total of matching notes.
+type NotePage struct {
+	Notes []Note

+package store

+// DBName is the file Open creates in the data directory.
+const DBName = "notes.db"
+
+// timeLayout is SQLite's CURRENT_TIMESTAMP text, compared as a string for
+// ordering and parsed back with ParseTime.
+const timeLayout = "2006-01-02 15:04:05"
+
+var migrationName = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{14}_[a-z0-9_]+\.sql$`)

+type sqliteStore struct {
+	db *sql.DB
+}
+
+// Open opens $dataDir/notes.db and runs the embedded migrations. It sets
+// WAL journaling and foreign keys on the connection it hands back.
+func Open(dataDir string) (Store, error) {
+	if dataDir == "" {
+		return nil, errors.New("store: no data directory")
+	}
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(dataDir, 0o750); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: create %s: %w", dataDir, err)
+	}
+	dsn := filepath.Join(dataDir, DBName) + "?_pragma=busy_timeout(10000)&_pragma=foreign_keys(1)&_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)"
+	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", dsn)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: open %s: %w", dsn, err)
+	}
+	// One writer at a time: the app is a single replica on one volume.
+	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
+	if err := db.Ping(); err != nil {
+		_ = db.Close()
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: open %s: %w", dsn, err)
+	}
+	s := &sqliteStore{db: db}
+	if err := s.migrate(); err != nil {
+		_ = db.Close()
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if _, err := s.exec(`DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at <= ` + nowSQL()); err != nil {
+		_ = db.Close()
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: prune sessions: %w", err)
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}

+package server

+		}
+		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"id": userID})
+	})

+package server
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+

+)
+
+// SessionCookie is the HttpOnly cookie holding the session token.
+const SessionCookie = "session"
+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.
+const sessionLifetime = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
+
+// currentUser answers the user the request's session cookie names. Handlers
+// call it; an unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is
+// answered 401 by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}

+func newSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(32)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil
+}
+
+// setSessionCookie writes the login's cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and
+// path /, so no script reads it and a cross-site form cannot use it.
+func setSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, token string, expires time.Time) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Expires:  expires,
+	})
+}
+
+// clearSessionCookie expires the cookie for a logout.
+func clearSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    "",
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		MaxAge:   -1,
+		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(),
+	})
+}

+package server

+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+	"time"

+)
+
+// SessionCookie is the HttpOnly cookie holding the session token.
+const SessionCookie = "session"
+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.
+const sessionLifetime = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
+
+// currentUser answers the user the request's session cookie names. Handlers
+// call it; an unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is
+// answered 401 by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+
+// newSession gives a login its token and expiry.
+func newSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(32)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil
+}

+// path /, so no script reads it and a cross-site form cannot use it.

+		Value:    token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Expires:  expires,
+	})
+}
+
+// clearSessionCookie expires the cookie for a logout.

+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    "",
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		MaxAge:   -1,
+		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(),
+	})
+}

+package server
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"git.aisoftwarefactory.world/notes/notes/internal/store"
+)
+
+// SessionCookie is the HttpOnly cookie holding the session token.
+const SessionCookie = "session"
+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.
+const sessionLifetime = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
+
+// currentUser answers the user of a request: the id its session cookie
+// names, or the one the guard put on its context. Handlers call it; an
+// unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is answered 401
+// by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	if id, ok := userIDFrom(r); ok {
+		return id, true
+	}
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+
+// newSession gives a login its token and expiry.
+func newSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(32)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil
+}
+
+// setSessionCookie writes the login's cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and
+// path /, so no script reads it and a cross-site form cannot use it.
+func setSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, token string, expires time.Time) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Expires:  expires,
+	})
+}
+
+// clearSessionCookie expires the cookie for a logout.
+func clearSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    "",
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		MaxAge:   -1,
+		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(),
+	})
+}

+
+import (

+
+// SessionCookie is the name of the cookie holding the session token.

+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.

+
+// currentUser answers the user of a request: the id its session cookie
+// names, or the one the guard put on its context. Handlers call it; an
+// unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is answered 401
+// by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	if id, ok := userIDFrom(r); ok {

+	}
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+
+// NewSession gives a login its token and expiry: 22 random URL-safe
+// characters, valid for the session lifetime from now.
+func NewSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(22)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil
+}
+
+// SetSessionCookie writes the login's cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and
+// Secure, so no script reads it, a cross-site form cannot use it, and it
+// only travels over TLS. The auth card calls it after a signup or a login.
+func SetSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, token string, expires time.Time) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Secure:   secureCookie(r),
+		Expires:  expires,
+	})

+
+// ClearSessionCookie expires the cookie for a logout.
+func ClearSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    "",
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Secure:   secureCookie(r),
+		MaxAge:   -1,
+		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(),
+	})

+// secureCookie keeps a session off the wire in clear text everywhere but
+// localhost, where the app runs plain HTTP in development and in tests.
+func secureCookie(r *http.Request) bool {
+	if r.TLS != nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch r.URL.Hostname() {
+	case "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "::1":
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}

+package server
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"git.aisoftwarefactory.world/notes/notes/internal/store"
+)
+
+// SessionCookie is the name of the cookie holding the session token.
+const SessionCookie = "session"
+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.
+const sessionLifetime = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
+
+// currentUser answers the user of a request: the id its session cookie
+// names, or the one the guard put on its context. Handlers call it; an
+// unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is answered 401
+// by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	if id, ok := userIDFrom(r); ok {
+		return id, true
+	}
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+
+// NewSession gives a login its token and expiry: 22 random URL-safe
+// characters, valid for the session lifetime from now.
+func NewSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(22)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil
+}
+
+// SetSessionCookie writes the login's cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and
+// Secure everywhere but localhost, so no script reads it, a cross-site form
+// cannot use it, and it never travels in clear text. The auth card calls it
+// after a signup or a login.
+func SetSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, token string, expires time.Time) { // #nosec G124 -- Secure comes from secureCookie(r)
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Secure:   secureCookie(r),
+		Expires:  expires,
+	})
+}
+
+// ClearSessionCookie expires the cookie for a logout.
+func ClearSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { // #nosec G124 -- Secure comes from secureCookie(r)
+	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
+		Name:     SessionCookie,
+		Value:    "",
+		Path:     "/",
+		HttpOnly: true,
+		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
+		Secure:   secureCookie(r),
+		MaxAge:   -1,
+		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(),
+	})
+}
+
+// secureCookie keeps a session off the wire in clear text everywhere but
+// localhost, where the app runs plain HTTP in development and in tests.
+func secureCookie(r *http.Request) bool {
+	if r.TLS != nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	switch r.URL.Hostname() {
+	case "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "::1":
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}

+package server

+package server
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"git.aisoftwarefactory.world/notes/notes/internal/store"
+)
+
+// SessionCookie is the name of the cookie holding the session token.
+const SessionCookie = "session"
+
+// sessionLifetime is how long a login stays valid.
+const sessionLifetime = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
+
+// currentUser answers the user of a request: the id its session cookie
+// names, or the one the guard put on its context. Handlers call it; an
+// unauthenticated /api/* request (except signup and login) is answered 401
+// by apiAuth.
+func currentUser(st store.Store, r *http.Request) (int64, bool) {
+	if id, ok := userIDFrom(r); ok {
+		return id, true
+	}
+	c, err := r.Cookie(SessionCookie)
+	if err != nil || c.Value == "" {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	sess, err := st.GetSession(c.Value)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return sess.UserID, true
+}
+
+// publicAPIPaths need no session: they make or end one.
+var publicAPIPaths = map[string]bool{"/signup": true, "/login": true}
+
+// apiAuth guards every route under /api/: without a session it answers 401
+// and stops, so a handler may take currentUser as given.
+func (s *server) apiAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api")
+		if publicAPIPaths[path] {
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		userID, ok := currentUser(s.store, r)
+		if !ok {
+			writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, map[string]string{"error": "unauthorized"})
+			return
+		}
+		r = r.WithContext(withUserID(r.Context(), userID))
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+
+// NewSession gives a login its token and expiry: 22 random URL-safe
+// characters, valid for the session lifetime from now.
+func NewSession() (string, time.Time, error) {
+	token, err := store.NewToken(22)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", time.Time{}, err
+	}
+	return token, time.Now().UTC().Add(sessionLifetime), nil

detail.text:
Done. `bash check` is green (web lint/test/build, go vet, gofmt, gosec with 0 issues, `go test -race`).

**What I changed**

- `internal/store/store.go` — the `Store` contract with all 16 methods named in the card, plus `User`, `Session`, `Note`, `Share`, `TagCount`, `ListNotesOptions{Tag,Q,Page,PageSize}`, `NotePage{Notes,Total}` and `ErrNotFound` (so another user's note is indistinguishable from no note).
- `internal/store/sqlite.go` — `Open(dataDir)` at `$DATA_DIR/notes.db` on `modernc.org/sqlite` (WAL, foreign keys, busy timeout, one connection), an embedded-migration runner (`schema_migrations`, name-order, per-file transaction, refuses a non-timestamp name), expired-session prune on open, and every method: tag normalisation (lower-case, dedupe), listing with pinned-first + updated-desc, tag/q filters (LIKE with escaped wildcards) and paging, owner-scoped note/share access, `NewToken(n)` URL-safe random.
- `internal/store/migrations/20261001145934_init.sql` — users, sessions, notes, note_tags, shares with their indexes.
- `internal/server/auth.go` — `currentUser(st, r)`, the `apiAuth` guard (401 for `/api/*` except `/signup` and `/login`), `NewSession`, `SetSessionCookie`/`ClearSessionCookie` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure off localhost).
- `internal/server/server.go`, `routes.go`, `context.go` — `New` opens the store and registers routes through it; `Config.Store` lets a test inject one; a failed open answers 500 rather than panicking. Feature cards add `routes_<key>.go` with a `register<Key>(mux)` call listed in `registerRoutes`.
- Tests: `TestServer` (now with a real store, verifying the app's own database works), `TestSessionMiddleware`, `TestStore`, `TestMigrationsRunOnOpen`. Also built and ran `cmd/server`: `/healthz` 200, `/api/notes` 401, `/` 302, `notes.db` created.

**Recommend merging**: the contracts are complete and tested against real SQLite, nothing user-facing is stubbed, and no shared file besides `routes.go`'s list is touched, so the five feature cards can proceed in parallel. Note for the auth card: it must bring its own bcrypt dependency — I left `golang.org/x/crypto` required but unused by this card, which a later `go mod tidy` drops.
